options.command: echo '[mc-service] test = test:unit + test:integration (threading is owned by scripts/mc-service-integration-guard.mjs)'

metadata.description: Both Rust tiers, in one command. It DELEGATES to test:unit and test:integration rather than invoking cargo itself, and that is the point (item #462 follow-on): the integration guard pins --test-threads=1, and when this target ran cargo directly it ran at DEFAULT parallelism, so `nx test mc-service` and the CI gate disagreed about the one setting that changes the result. logging_middleware_emits_structured_json failed ~2 runs in 3 locally and stayed green in CI for months because of exactly that gap. Do not give this target its own --test-threads; a second copy is a second thing to drift. Pinned by scripts/__tests__/mc-service-lint-all-targets.guard.test.mjs.

clippy over mc-service with warnings denied. `--all-targets` IS LOAD-BEARING AND IS NOT A TIDY-UP (item #229): without it clippy checks the lib and bins only, and since `test:unit` runs `--lib`, NOTHING in the fast `app-ci / mc-service-checks` gate compiles backend/mc-service/tests/**. That gate went green on PR #216 (reqwest 0.12 -> 0.13) while all three integration test binaries failed to compile, because `RequestBuilder::form` became feature-gated and the ROPC helper calls it; `app-e2e` reported it ~35 minutes later as an opaque step name, and on a Cargo-only PR — Cargo.lock is deliberately outside the `changes` job's `app` filter — app-e2e does not run at all. `--all-targets` compiles lib, bins and tests WITHOUT running them and WITHOUT a database, so it belongs in the fast job by construction. It does not replace `test:integration`, which still runs those tests against a replica-set Mongo in app-e2e. Pinned by scripts/__tests__/mc-service-lint-all-targets.guard.test.mjs. The flag must stay BEFORE the bare `--`: everything after it is passed to the lint driver, which does not accept it.
